component.name: aws-bedrock
component.title: AWS Bedrock
component.description: Invoke Amazon Bedrock foundation models with the InvokeModel and Converse APIs, and check content with Bedrock guardrails.
component.label: ai,cloud

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

guardrailIdentifier.description: The ID or ARN of the guardrail to apply. converse and converseStream apply it when the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailConfig header is not set, and applyGuardrail uses it when the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailIdentifier header is not set. Not used with pojoRequest.

guardrailStreamProcessingMode.description: How converseStream applies the guardrail of the guardrailIdentifier option to the streamed response. With sync, Bedrock buffers the chunks and checks them with the guardrail before it sends them. With async, Bedrock sends the chunks at once and checks them in the background, so chunks that the guardrail would block can be sent before it blocks the rest, and masking of sensitive information is not supported. Not used when the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailConfig header is set.

guardrailTrace.description: Whether converse and converseStream ask for the trace of the guardrail of the guardrailIdentifier option, which the producer gives in the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailTrace header. Not used when the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailConfig header is set, and not used by applyGuardrail.

guardrailVersion.description: The version of the guardrail, a number such as 1, or DRAFT for its working draft. converse and converseStream use it together with guardrailIdentifier, and applyGuardrail also with the guardrail of the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailIdentifier header.

includeStreamingMetadata.description: Whether the streaming operations and converseStream set headers about the response: the chunk count, the completion reason and the token count for the invoke operations, and the chunk count, stop reason, usage and guardrail trace for converseStream, each when the model sends it.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

modelId.description: The ID of the model to invoke, for example anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0, or of a cross-region inference profile, such as us.anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0, or its ARN. invokeTextModel and the streaming operations read the response in the format of the model family that the ID names. applyGuardrail does not use it, and with pojoRequest the model of the request is used instead.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsBedrockOperation header replaces this option. The invokeImageModelStreaming and invokeEmbeddingsModelStreaming operations are deprecated, as the image generation and embedding models do not stream: use invokeImageModel, invokeEmbeddingsModel or invokeTextModelStreaming instead.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, which the producer sends as it is: an InvokeModelRequest for the invoke operations, an InvokeModelWithResponseStreamRequest for the streaming ones, or a ConverseRequest, ConverseStreamRequest or ApplyGuardrailRequest. The options and headers that build the request are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Bedrock, as a region ID such as us-east-1, which is the value of Region.US_EAST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

streamOutputMode.description: How the streaming operations and converseStream give the response: complete gives the whole text as a String, and chunks gives a List of the text of each chunk. In both modes the producer waits until the model has finished. The CamelAwsBedrockStreamOutputMode header replaces this option.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

bedrockRuntimeAsyncClient.label: advanced
bedrockRuntimeAsyncClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockruntime.BedrockRuntimeAsyncClient for the streaming operations: invokeTextModelStreaming, its deprecated variants and converseStream. When it is not set, the endpoint builds one from the credentials, region, proxy and endpoint override options, also when bedrockRuntimeClient is set. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

bedrockRuntimeClient.label: advanced
bedrockRuntimeClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockruntime.BedrockRuntimeClient for the operations that do not stream: invokeTextModel, invokeImageModel, invokeEmbeddingsModel, converse and applyGuardrail. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used for this client. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime use to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime trust every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsBedrockOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsBedrockContentType.description: The MIME type of the request body of the invoke operations, usually application/json. The invoke operations fail without it, unless pojoRequest is true.

CamelAwsBedrockAcceptContentType.description: The MIME type of the response that the invoke operations ask the model for, usually application/json. The invoke operations fail without it, unless pojoRequest is true.

CamelAwsBedrockStreamOutputMode.description: The output mode of the streaming operations and converseStream: complete or chunks. It replaces the streamOutputMode option.

CamelAwsBedrockCompletionReason.description: The reason why the model stopped generating, in the terms of its model family, such as end_turn or FINISH. Set by the streaming invoke operations when includeStreamingMetadata is true and the model sends it.

CamelAwsBedrockTokenCount.description: The number of tokens that the model generated. Set by the streaming invoke operations when includeStreamingMetadata is true and the model sends a count.

CamelAwsBedrockChunkCount.description: The number of chunks of the response stream. Set by the streaming invoke operations and converseStream when includeStreamingMetadata is true.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseMessages.description: The messages of the conversation for converse and converseStream, as a List of Message of the AWS SDK. When not set, the body as text is sent as one user message.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseSystem.description: The system prompts for converse and converseStream, as a List of SystemContentBlock of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseInferenceConfig.description: The inference parameters for converse and converseStream, such as maxTokens, temperature and topP.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseToolConfig.description: The tools that the model can ask to use in converse and converseStream, and how it chooses them.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseAdditionalFields.description: The request fields of the model that the Converse API does not define, for converse and converseStream, as a Document of the AWS SDK.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseStopReason.description: The reason why the model stopped generating, such as end_turn, tool_use or max_tokens. Set by converse, and by converseStream when includeStreamingMetadata is true.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseUsage.description: The input, output and total token counts of the request. Set by converse, and by converseStream when includeStreamingMetadata is true.

CamelAwsBedrockConverseOutputMessage.description: The message that the model returned, with all its content blocks, such as the requests to use a tool, while the body has only its text. Set by converse only.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailConfig.description: The guardrail to apply in converse and converseStream, as a GuardrailConfiguration of the AWS SDK; converseStream also takes a GuardrailStreamConfiguration. It replaces the guardrailIdentifier, guardrailVersion and guardrailTrace options.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailIdentifier.description: The ID or ARN of the guardrail for applyGuardrail. It replaces the guardrailIdentifier option. converse and converseStream do not read it.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailContent.description: The content that applyGuardrail checks, as a List of GuardrailContentBlock of the AWS SDK. When not set, the body as text is checked.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailSource.description: Whether applyGuardrail checks the content as the input of a model (INPUT) or as its output (OUTPUT). The default is INPUT.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailOutput.description: The output of the guardrail, such as the blocked message or the text with masked content. Set by applyGuardrail when the guardrail returns it.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailTrace.description: The trace of the guardrail evaluation. Set by converse, and by converseStream when includeStreamingMetadata is true, when the trace of the guardrail is enabled.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailAssessments.description: The assessments of the policies of the guardrail, such as its content and topic policies. Set by applyGuardrail.

CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailUsage.description: The number of text units that each policy of the guardrail processed. Set by applyGuardrail.

producerIn.description: The request of the model as JSON text for the invoke operations, which also need the CamelAwsBedrockContentType and CamelAwsBedrockAcceptContentType headers. Bytes, a stream or a file are sent as they are, and a Map or a Jackson JsonNode is marshalled to JSON: marshal another POJO to JSON first. No body fails. converse and converseStream take the messages of the CamelAwsBedrockConverseMessages header, or else the body as text as one user message; applyGuardrail takes the CamelAwsBedrockGuardrailContent header, or else the body as text. With pojoRequest=true an InvokeModelRequest of the AWS SDK: another body fails

producerOut.description: The streaming operations and converseStream give the text, or a List of the chunks with streamOutputMode=chunks: an image or embedding model fails, as it does not stream. invokeTextModel gives the JSON response as text for the Amazon Titan models, and a Jackson JsonNode for the others: the response, or the generated text for Llama, Cohere and Claude 2. invokeImageModel gives a JsonNode array of the images as Base64 text, and invokeEmbeddingsModel the InvokeModelResponse of the AWS SDK. converse gives the answer as text, empty when the model asks for a tool, and applyGuardrail its action as text: NONE or GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The producer does not use it: the model and the operation are given by options and headers.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Runtime use to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
